contexts.text: These words... are words of exhortation to those who are in the Church, to be in the good of faith...
Internal exhortation and hearing. Signified. (For) to be called by God... = influx from the Divine.
Thou shalt say to Pharaoh = exhortation. (For) to say, when done by Divine command, = exhortation. AC 7034.
It first treats of those who were infesting, that they did not attend at all to the Divine exhortation.
They said to Pharaoh = exhortation to those who are against the truths of the Church.
That he was unwilling to hearken to the Lord's exhortation. Signified.
This delight of their life is augmented by exhortations to desist. Explained.
Exhortation by the Divine law to those who are of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. Signified.
Jehovah said to Moses = exhortation by the Divine. (For) to sayinvolves the things which follow, which are words of exhortation...
Exhortation and effort to amend. Signified.
Exhortation by the Lord to all, both those who are in that religiosity and to those who are not in it, to beware of conjunction with it... Signified. AE 1106:2.
Exhortation thence not to do such things...
Saying with a great voice = exhortation. AE 884.
I heard another voice saying from Heaven = exhortation to those who are in truths and the good of life to beware of them.
